headline: Candy Crush: 5.9 billion dollar deal
title: Candy Crush Maker Sold for Nearly Six Billion Dollars | Candy Crush Facts | Classic Games
video_script: Candy Crush looks simple, but it is a giant. Its maker King launched it in twenty twelve. In November twenty fifteen, Activision Blizzard announced it would buy King for five point nine billion dollars, and the deal closed in February twenty sixteen. King later said the Candy Crush franchise passed twenty billion dollars in lifetime revenue. Which level stopped you? Comment below!
description: Candy Crush Saga launched in 2012. Activision Blizzard announced in November 2015 it would buy King for 5.9 billion dollars, closing in February 2016. King later reported the franchise passed 20 billion dollars in lifetime revenue (September 2023).
